# Ethisyn

> We build software, automate your operations, and help your business grow online.
> Independent Digital Product Engineering & Autonomous AI Systems Studio.

- [Website](https://ethisyn.in): Official digital studio home
- Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Founded: 2022
- Direct Inquiries: hello@ethisyn.in
- Studio Model: Founding Domain Partners directing client systems, with internal Autonomous AI Agent Lab in active R&D.
- [Full Knowledge Corpus](https://ethisyn.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical specifications and FAQ

## Core Studio Capabilities
- [High-Performance Web Engineering](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Sub-second Next.js, React, TypeScript, edge caching, zero layout shift.
- [Mobile Platform Development](https://ethisyn.in/#services): iOS and Android applications with sub-second touch responsiveness and offline sync.
- [AI Automation & Voice Systems](https://ethisyn.in/#ai): Custom business automation workflows, voice bots, and enterprise search tools.
- [Distributed Cloud & Backend Systems](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Enterprise microservices, PostgreSQL, Spring Boot, high-concurrency architectures.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Ground-truth indexing across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Technical SEO & Growth Engineering](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Product-led acquisition, local SEO dominance, performance marketing.
- [UI/UX Design Systems](https://ethisyn.in/#services): Figma design engineering, intuitive user flows, micro-interactions, responsive interfaces.

## Studio Commitments
- 100% In-House: Zero outsourcing to mystery freelancers; clients collaborate directly with founding partners.
- Sub-Second Performance: Verified on real mobile devices under high network constraints.
- Response SLA: Inquiries triaged and answered within 4 business hours.
- Strict Privacy: Zero street/door number disclosures; established in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
